text_block_list.text: Uh... Hey.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I wanna stop by a bookstore.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
At Нарита Таисин's request, we head to a
nearby
shopping mall in search of a
bookstore.
choice_data_list: So what are you looking to buy?

text_block_list.text:
What? Oh, I'm not buying anything for
myself.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Actually, it's none of your business. I'll
only be
gone a second, so just wait for
me here.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I'll be right back.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Oh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Fancy seeing you here.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Yeah.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Well... See you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Later.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Hey!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hm? What?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Are, uh... Are the books there part of
that series
Hayahide likes?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hm... Oh, yeah. I remember seeing a
bunch of
them on her bookshelves.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: You gonna buy more for her?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I mean... I guess.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hayahide's freakin' overbearing and
annoying,
and there's no shutting her up
once she gets
started on something...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: But... she also helps me out a lot.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Sounds like her.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
She's a total busybody, talks in the most
bizarre
way, and her thought process is
weird as hell,
but...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I get you. She helps me out a lot too.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hey, can you show me what other books
she
might like?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Sure, I can help out for a bit.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hey, I'm back. Let's go.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I didn't mean to eavesdrop, but I
actually
overheard their whole
conversation.
choice_data_list: I'm sure Hayahide will be thrilled.

text_block_list.text:
I didn't mean to eavesdrop, but I
actually

conversation.
choice_data_list: I'm sure Hayahide will be thrilled.

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what are you talking about?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Stop sticking your nose in things that
aren't your
business, unless you want me
to kick your butt!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Kay.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: So what kinda books do you like?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Our conversation on the way back home
feels a
bit livelier than usual.

I may have angered Нарита Таисин, but
it's still
heartwarming to see how
thoughtful she actually
is.
